utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can lend you a hammer and a screwdriver set for the repair drive. What do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I’ll take the tape and screws most of all, and I’ll check for any spare lightbulbs too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can set aside the tape and screws for you, and I’ll look for a few spare lightbulbs too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please send them over—I just want to make sure I’ve got the time and place right.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time and place exactly? I’d rather have the details straight before I go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Absolutely — I’m checking the time and place so I can pass it along exactly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll help spread it around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I’m still sorting through what needs fixing, but I’ll send you the list as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — once you send it, I’ll pass it along and help get the neighbors lined up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Morning sounds best — how does 9 to 11 on Saturday look for the repair drive? If that works, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: 9 to 11 on Saturday works well — I’ll send the repair drive details again so everyone has them in one place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Mara — I’ll help get the word out so folks see the details in one place.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly tape, screws, and a few spare lightbulbs would help a lot. If you can grab any of those, I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring what I can and keep it quiet. I’ll slip by after dusk and check the back fence first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — that helps a lot. I’ll keep track of what’s still needed and be ready for you after dusk.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the exact list yet, but I can ask around and find out what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Tess — thanks. Once you have the list, send it my way and I’ll help spread the word around the school crowd.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and get you the list as soon as I can. I’ll send it your way once I’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd is the closest stop with tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect — I’ll note the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd as the closest stop with tools. I’m still confirming the last details, and I’ll send the full update as soon as everything’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — that’s all I needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you bring any extra screws and a few hand tools if you have them? If you’re free, sorting tools and handing things out would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can bring extra screws and a few hand tools, and I’ll help sort and hand things out too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the time and place right over, so you’ve got it handy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll watch for it and wait for the confirmed details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’m sending the confirmed time and place now, so you’ll have everything handy.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Head to the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd — that’s the closest stop with tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, that works for me—I’ll head to the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd and keep the plan simple.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—Maple and 3rd is the right stop. If you need anything else on the repair drive, just tell me and I’ll point you there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — I’m still good for the hammer and screwdriver set. Where should I pick them up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send the pickup details one more time so I don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can send them again. Just let me know the best way to share the pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — that sounds perfect. I’ll keep you posted on the repair drive details while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. I’m a little fuzzy, but I remember the loose fence, the porch step, and that leaky gutter.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll keep those three on the list and check what needs the most help first. I’ll update you when I’m back from errands.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
